crossRefs.note: After he had sent the multitudes away, he went up into the mountain by himself to pray. When evening had come, he was…
When evening came, his disciples went down to the sea.
They entered into the boat, and were going over the sea to Capernaum. It was now dark, and Jesus had not come to them.

translations.web: When evening had come, the boat was in the middle of the sea, and he was alone on the land.
translations.bsb: When evening came, the boat was in the middle of the sea, and Jesus was alone on land.
translations.kjv: And when even was come, the ship was in the midst of the sea, and he alone on the land.
translations.asv: And when even was come, the boat was in the midst of the sea, and he alone on the land.
